_about: The economy layer over #79 — NOT a second farm spec. Plot model, stage clock (#19), tend/yield rules, harvest, and the fruit table are #79's and are not restated here; if the two ever disagree about a plot, #79 is right. This fragment is the generalised crop record + the economy joins. Zero crop contents asserted.

crop_record_generalised.weather_affinity: optional — one weather state + direction (per-crop data, OPEN)

ethics: no real-money anything, ever (#56 M4; #20 one-currency rule); no fail state — neglect shrinks yield, never kills (#79 care register)

joins.economy: yields are #31 items; sale prices + the PROPOSED 1/2 sell fraction + the currency name are #20's — none re-ruled here
joins.shops: #118 stock rows may cite a cultivation source; stock contents/gates stay #118/#20 data
joins.sites: plot clusters on #7 areas or #119 host nodes (greenhouse weather reads only via #119's exception field); tended by NPCs (#93 timetables) or by the Ranger where the plot is theirs (#79)
joins.yields_belong_to: the plot's tender — an NPC's field is an economy source and world texture, never a Ranger harvest target; no taking is defined

open_register: plot counts + field sites beyond #79's canon references
the calendar + seasons (standing gap — #93/#105/#124; seasonal windows are slots keyed to the calendar-when-ruled)
whether Ranger-owned field plots exist beyond Garden/route plots
